title: Add docs entries for missing optimizers
body:
Several optimizers are missing from the relevant page of the docs. I have frequently found myself recommending ABC-FIRE or GoodOldQuasiNewton only to discover that they are undocumented.

It would be nice to add a bit more writing about them. (Especially GOQN, it is unclear to me if it is a variation on (L)BFGS.) But at least this puts on them on the map.
